# Salty Dog Tags (all pages)

> Funny, personalized, laser-engraved dog ID tags from a Lehi, Utah family with seven English bulldogs. A joke or saying goes on the front; the dog's name and owner's phone number go on the back. From $12, engraved in Lehi, Utah and shipped by USPS (1-2 business days, then 3-5 days in transit).

## Your dog's face. On steel.

The laser grows the color into the stainless. It's not paint, it's the metal itself. Photos go on polished stainless in grayscale; we email a proof before we burn.

How it works

## Four steps. No app.

No account, no password, no subscription. Just a tag, in the mail, with your number on it.

- **01**

### Build it

Pick a saying or write your own, add the name and number, choose a finish.

- **02**

### We invoice you

Within a day you get a secure Clover invoice by email. Pay it with any card. No account, no password.

- **03**

### We laser it

Engraved in our shop, checked against your order, and photographed before it goes in the envelope.

- **04**

### It ships

Engraved and shipped within 1 to 2 business days of payment. USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.

- We mis-engrave it, we remake it free.
- Chewed or lost it? First replacement is $5 flat.
- You get a photo of your exact tag before it ships.

Checkout

## Send it over.

Nothing is charged here. We review the order, send a Clover invoice to your email, and start engraving when it's paid.

Shipped USPS from Lehi, Utah, US only: $4.50, free over $35. Utah sales tax is added for Utah orders only.

Questions humans ask

## Straight answers.

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**How do I pay?**

After you send the order we email you a Clover invoice. It's a secure payment page from the same company that runs our card readers. Any card works. We never see your card number.

**How long does it take?**

We engrave and ship within 1 to 2 business days of payment, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only. If it will take longer, we email you first. If you have a deadline, say so in the notes and we'll tell you straight.

**What if it's wrong?**

Engraved means it's custom to you, so no returns on custom tags. If we made a mistake, or the engraving isn't right, send a photo and we remake it free.

**What is the Bulldog Promise?**

Three things, in writing. If we mis-engrave your tag, we remake it free. If your dog chews it or loses it, the first replacement is $5 flat. And before your tag ships, we send you a photo of the exact tag, so there are no surprises. That's the whole promise. No fine print hiding behind it. We have seven bulldogs, so we know what happens to tags.

**Can I write my own saying?**

Yes, and please do. Up to three lines on the front, 24 characters each. The name and number go on the back. The preview shows exactly what fits. If it's too long we'll email you before we engrave.

**Will the engraving wear off?**

No. It's cut into the metal, not printed on top. The colored tags are anodized aluminum, so the laser removes the color and exposes bright silver underneath. Stainless and brass get a deep dark mark. Our own dogs have worn these through salt water, sand and whatever is in the yard.

**Can you put my dog's photo on it?**

Yes, on polished stainless. Upload a clear, well-lit photo and we engrave it in grayscale on the front; the name and number still go on the back. We email you a proof before we touch the laser, because a bad photo makes a bad tag and we'd rather tell you first.

**What's the color stuff?**

Our laser can mark color directly into stainless steel, no ink or paint. The color is grown into the steel by the laser; it's not a coating, so it wears like the engraving does. It's new, so we recommend it on the front and off anything that takes a beating.

**Do you make cat tags?**

Yes. The 32 mm round or the heart sit fine on a cat collar. The cat will still not wear it, but that's between you and the cat.

**Where do the bulldog puppies come in?**

Separate thing, same family. We breed English bulldogs occasionally. Email us if you're interested and we'll talk. Tags ship to anyone; puppies don't.

Whisky's real tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY, Yes, I lick my own junk, We can't all be perfect, and a phone number

Whisky's actual tag. Polished stainless, paw cut-out, straight off our laser.

The management

## Seven English bulldogs. One laser.

We didn't start a dog tag company because we're crafty. We started it because we have seven bulldogs, they kept losing tags, and the boring ones at the pet store cost more than a decent lunch.

We also breed English bulldogs. Litters are occasional and the waiting list is real. If you're looking for one, [email us](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com?subject=Bulldog%20puppies) and tell us about your home. We ask a lot of questions. The dogs would want us to.

## Show us your dog. Win a tag.

Post a photo of your dog wearing a Salty Dog tag, or any tag, with #SaltyDogTags or email it to [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com?subject=Tag%20pic). One winner a month, picked by the humans for the best face. Free tag, our choice of shape. No purchase necessary. [Full rules](https://saltydogtags.com/policies#contest).

# Roast My Dog: a free AI roast from one photo

> Roast my dog, free: upload one photo and a name and our AI writes a roast in seconds. Like it? We laser-engrave the best line on a tag from $12.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/roast/

Show us the dog. We'll write the tag.


Free roast from one photo and a name. Engraved on steel by a family with seven English bulldogs.

Example match

Whisky is a 94% match
Top matches. Tap one to put it on the tag.

Written just for Whisky

Bulldog Promise: we misengrave it, we remake it free.

How it works

## Photo in. Tag out.

- **Show us the dog.**A photo and a name. Add what he's like if you want the good jokes.
- **We write the roast.**Five lines picked or written for your dog. Flick the tag, pick a favorite, send it to the group chat.
- **We engrave it.**Saying on the front, name and phone on the back. From $12, ships USPS in 3 to 5 days.

# Custom Funny Dog Tags From a Lehi Bulldog Family

> Funny custom dog tags, laser engraved in Lehi, Utah by a family with seven English bulldogs. Utah sayings, USPS shipping anywhere in the US, from $12.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/utah-dog-tags/

We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs, one laser engraver, and strong opinions about what a dog tag should say. The front gets a joke. The back gets your dog's name and your phone number. Every tag is engraved here in Utah County, checked against your order, photographed, and mailed out USPS. No warehouse, no middleman. Just our laser and the post office.

## Engraved in Lehi

Lehi is where the laser lives. It's a valley town with a mountain on one side and a lake on the other, and a lot of new yards with dogs working out where the gate is. Our seven bulldogs supervise. They don't help, but they inspect every finished tag, mostly by trying to eat it. If you live in Lehi, American Fork, Saratoga Springs, Orem, Provo or Draper, you're practically next door, and your tag has a short trip to your mailbox.

## Built for Utah dogs

Utah weather asks a lot of a dog. Snow in April, a scorching July, a trailhead colder than the parking lot. The tag stays on the collar through all of it, doing one quiet job: giving a stranger your number. Our own dogs have worn theirs through salt water, sand and whatever is in the yard, and the words are cut into the metal, not printed on top.

## Fast across the Wasatch Front

We engrave and ship from Lehi within 1 to 2 business days of payment, and USPS takes about 3 to 5 days in transit. A Wasatch Front address, anywhere from Provo up through Salt Lake to Ogden, is a short trip from our laser. Shipping is $4.50 and free over $35. Utah orders include Utah sales tax. Need it by a date, like a birthday, a trip to the mountains or a gotcha day? Put the deadline in the order notes and we'll tell you straight whether we can make it.

## How it works

- Pick one of the [181 sayings](https://saltydogtags.com/sayings/) or write your own in [the builder](https://saltydogtags.com/#build). The preview shows what fits.
- Add your dog's name and phone number for the back.
- Pay on Clover's secure page. We engrave it in Lehi and ship it USPS.

- [American Fork and everywhere else](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/dog-parks-utah-county/#american-fork-and-others)
- [Before you go: leash, water, bags](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/dog-parks-utah-county/#before-you-go)

Bring a leash even to the dog park. You'll need it in the parking lot. Headed south? We did the same for [St. George dog parks and trails](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/).

## Licenses are a separate tag

Your dog's license tag comes from your city or county. The ID tag with your number comes from us. It's an ID tag, not a license or rabies tag. We wrote down the official rules for [Utah dog licenses in Lehi and Salt Lake County](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/utah-dog-license-and-tag-rules/) so you don't have to hunt for them. Down in Washington County, see [dog tags for St. George](https://saltydogtags.com/st-george-dog-tags/) and the [St. George license rules](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-license-rules/).

# St. George Dog Tags, Engraved by a Utah Bulldog Family

> Funny custom dog tags for St. George and Washington County dogs, laser engraved and shipped USPS. Local sayings, license and dog park guides, from $12.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/st-george-dog-tags/

We're a bulldog family moving to St. George in early 2027. Until the laser makes the trip, every tag is engraved in Lehi, checked against your order, photographed, and mailed USPS to your St. George or Washington County address. The front gets a joke. The back gets your dog's name and your phone number, cut into the metal by a laser, not printed on top.

## Why a St. George dog needs a tag that reads

Down here a loose dog has two problems: the heat and the clock. Utah State Parks says daytime temperatures at [Snow Canyon State Park](https://stateparks.utah.gov/parks/snow-canyon/current-conditions/) frequently top 105 degrees in July and August. And shelters keep office hours. The [St. George Animal Shelter](https://www.sgcityutah.gov/departments/police_department/animal_services___shelter.php) is by appointment only and closed Sundays, and the [Washington City shelter](https://washingtonutah.gov/services/publicsafety/police/animalwelfare) is open Monday to Friday, 9 to 4, closed weekends and holidays.

A license number on a Saturday afternoon means waiting for an office to open. Your phone number on the tag means a call right now. That's the whole job of an ID tag: digits a stranger can read and dial. Our [desert heat guide](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/desert-heat-dog-safety-st-george/) has the rest, from the pavement test to hot cars, straight from the park and weather service pages.

## Three tags on a Washington County collar

- **The license tag** from your city. In St. George it's $10 for a spayed or neutered dog and $20 otherwise, renewed every year by February 28 ([city page](https://sgcityutah.gov/doglicense/)). Washington City, Hurricane and Ivins each run their own program, with their own fees. Our [St. George license rules guide](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-license-rules/) has all four.
- **The rabies tag** from your vet. Hurricane spells it out: a license and rabies tag must be attached to your dog's collar ([Hurricane City](https://www.cityofhurricane.com/159/Animal-Control-Shelter)).
- **An ID tag with your number.** That's the one we make. It's an ID tag, not a license or rabies tag, so it doesn't replace either of the other two.

Want a backup? On tags that support it, a $5 scan-to-find QR goes on the back. It opens a finder page for your dog, with email alerts to you once you activate it. The phone number stays engraved too, because a QR needs a signal.

## Shipping to St. George

We engrave and ship within 1 to 2 business days of payment, and USPS takes about 3 to 5 days in transit from Lehi to Washington County. Shipping is $4.50 and free on orders of $35 or more. Utah orders include Utah sales tax. Need it by a date, like a gotcha day or the first Snow Canyon hike? Put the deadline in the order notes and we'll tell you straight whether we can make it.

## How it works

- Pick one of the [181 sayings](https://saltydogtags.com/sayings/) or write your own in [the builder](https://saltydogtags.com/#build). The preview shows what fits.
- Add your dog's name and phone number for the back.
- Pay on Clover's secure page. We engrave it and ship it USPS.

We wrote these for red rock, hot pavement and Washington County trail dogs. Tap any of them to load it into the builder, or change a word to make it yours. Each line is 24 characters or fewer.

## Where St. George dogs run

The City of St. George lists three fenced dog parks, and the neighbors have their own. Our [dog parks and trails guide](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/) has the addresses and the rules from each city, state and park page:

- [St. George: Firehouse, J.C. Snow and Riverbend parks](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/#st-george)
- [Washington City: Dog Town Dog Park](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/#washington-city)
- [Hurricane: the city dog park](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/#hurricane)
- [Snow Canyon State Park: every trail, on a 6-foot leash](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/#snow-canyon)
- [Red Cliffs Desert Reserve: leash on, stay on the trail](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/#red-cliffs)
- [Zion: the Pa'rus Trail only](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/#zion)

Bring a leash even to the dog park. Every set of rules on that list wants it on at the gate.

## Around Washington County

Rules change at the city line, so we keep each city in its own section of the guides instead of pretending one set fits all:

- **Washington City** licenses dogs for two years ($20 altered, $40 unaltered on the city's fee schedule) and wants dogs on a 6-foot leash in city parks. See [Washington City license rules](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-license-rules/#washington-city) and [Dog Town Dog Park](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-parks-and-trails/#washington-city).
- **Hurricane** wants a license by 4 months and the license and rabies tag on the collar. See [Hurricane license rules](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-license-rules/#hurricane).
- **Ivins and Santa Clara** share one public safety department, with an animal control office in Ivins. An Ivins license lasts until the rabies certificate expires. See [Ivins and Santa Clara](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/st-george-dog-license-rules/#ivins-and-santa-clara).

Elsewhere in Utah? The [Utah dog tags page](https://saltydogtags.com/utah-dog-tags/) covers the Wasatch Front.

## Same family, different sugar

Our family also runs [Thirsty Beaches](https://thirstybeaches.com), dirty sodas, soft serve and espresso, opening first in St. George. Different product, same people, same opinions about shade.

# Shop Policies

> Salty Dog Tags shop policies in plain English: terms of sale, shipping, returns and remakes, cancellations, user content, the photo contest and governing law.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/policies/

Last updated: November 17, 2026

The rules of the shop, in plain English. Questions: [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). Also see our [privacy policy](https://saltydogtags.com/privacy/).

[Terms of sale](https://saltydogtags.com/policies/#terms) · [Shipping](https://saltydogtags.com/policies/#shipping) · [Returns & remakes](https://saltydogtags.com/policies/#returns) · [Cancellations](https://saltydogtags.com/policies/#cancellations) · [User content & 18+](https://saltydogtags.com/policies/#content) · [Monthly photo contest](https://saltydogtags.com/policies/#contest) · [Governing law](https://saltydogtags.com/policies/#law)

## Terms of sale

- **Who you're buying from:** Salty Dog Tags, a one-person shop in Lehi, Utah.
- **Prices** are in US dollars, as shown at checkout. The 15% off 3+ tags applies to the base tag price, not color or photo add-ons. Salty Maze upgrade codes are one use, good 30 days, and need a stainless, polished or brass tag.
- **Sales tax:** Utah sales tax is added to orders shipped to a Utah address. We don't collect tax for other states right now.
- **Paying:** nothing is charged when you send an order. We email you a secure Clover invoice, usually within a day, and you pay it with any card or Apple Pay. We never see your card number. By sending an order you agree to these policies.
- **Your order is accepted** once you've paid and we've approved any uploaded art. If we decline it (see Artwork), you pay nothing or get a full refund. You must be 18 or older to order, or have a parent or guardian order for you.
- **Proofs:** photo tags get an emailed proof before engraving. Text that won't fit gets an email first. Every tag is photographed before it ships.
- **Custom designs ("We design it" on full-color tags):** Bold type is free. The mascot, synthwave and photo styles add a $2 design fee per design. We start the design after your invoice is paid, email you a proof, and include one round of changes. If you still don't like it, we print your saying in Bold type at no extra charge instead. The design fee isn't refunded once we've sent the proof.
- **Bulldog Promise:** see Returns & remakes.
- **What we owe:** at most, what you paid for that order. These are ID tags, not GPS, so keep the info current. Nothing here takes away rights the law gives you.

## Shipping

- **US addresses only:** the 50 states and DC. No APO/FPO or territories right now.
- **$4.50 flat USPS**, free when your order is $35+ after discounts, before tax.
- **Timing:** we engrave and ship from Lehi within 1 to 2 business days of payment (photo tags and custom designs: of proof approval), then USPS takes about 3 to 5 days in transit. If we'll miss that window, we'll email you, and you can cancel for a full refund.
- **Lost or damaged in transit:** email your order number within 30 days of the expected delivery date. We'll deal with USPS and remake it free. No waiting on the claim.
- **Wrong address:** if the address you entered was wrong, a reship or remake is priced like a typo remake.

## Returns & remakes

Every tag and ornament is made just for you, so no returns. Instead:

- **Our mistake:** if the engraving doesn't match your order, or the tag is defective, email a photo within 30 days of delivery. Free remake, free shipping.
- **Your typo:** we engrave exactly what you ordered, so check spelling and phone number twice. If the typo was yours, we remake at a discount.
- **Chewed or lost:** first replacement $5 flat.
- **Full-color printed tags.** Printed color isn't as tough as engraving. On a working collar it scuffs and fades with wear, and faster with chewing, swimming and rough play. Normal wear isn't a defect. If the print peels or flakes within 30 days of delivery, that's on us: free remake.
- **Gifts.** The buyer is our customer for the invoice, approvals and remakes. A gift recipient can email us the order number to get a remake under the same rules. We use a recipient's name and address only to deliver.
- **Refunds** go back to your original card through Clover. Your bank sets the timing, usually a few business days.

## Cancellations

Cancel anytime before your tag is engraved: email your order number and you'll get a full refund. Once the laser runs, the tag is yours, unless we miss the shipping window above.

## User content & 18+

- **What you send:** you're responsible for your text and photos. Only upload photos you took or may use, and skip logos you don't have rights to. You let us use them to make your tag and run the roast. We can refuse anything hateful, threatening, harassing or infringing, and refund you.
- **Roast results are written by AI.** They can be wrong, weird, or over the line. Read every word before ordering. We engrave what you order.
- **Salty 18+** has real swear words and is for adults only. You confirm you're 18+ before it opens, and your browser remembers that. Ordering an 18+ saying means you're 18 or older. "Ruder than I expected" isn't a remake reason.
- **Tag us:** when you tag us in a post of your dog or email us a photo, you let us repost it with credit on our site (including the Wall of Shame) and our socials, free. You still own it. Ask and we'll take it down from our site and accounts within 7 days. We can't recall copies others shared. Please don't send photos of other people's kids.

## Your artwork & photos

- **What you can send:** photos you took, art you made, or images whose owner gave you permission to have them printed. Not allowed: logos, team or brand names, cartoon or movie characters, celebrity or public-figure photos, or someone else's photo or art (including another person's pet pic from social media) without their permission.
- **People in photos:** fine, if everyone shown agreed to be on it. For anyone under 18, a parent or guardian must agree.
- **You keep ownership.** You let us store, crop, resize, color-correct and print your image to make, ship and remake your order. Nothing else: no ads and no social posts unless you separately tell us yes in writing. (Tag us, above, is separate.)
- **Your promise:** ticking the artwork box confirms the rules above. If that turns out to be untrue and someone brings a claim against us over your image or text, you agree to cover our reasonable costs of that claim, including any amount we have to pay.
- **What we decline:** we check every upload by hand. We decline art we believe infringes someone's rights; nudity or sexual content; any 18+ wording or saying next to a person who looks under 18; and anything hateful, threatening or harassing. Swear words in your own art follow the Salty 18+ rule: adults only. Declining isn't an accusation, and we don't have to give legal reasons.
- **If we decline:** we email you within 2 business days. Not paid yet: the invoice is cancelled, nothing is charged, and you can send new art or pick a house style. Already paid: we refund the declined item, plus its share of shipping and tax, to your card within 3 business days. Or cancel the whole order for a full refund. We never print declined art.
- **Rights complaints:** if you think something we made uses your work or your brand, email hello@saltydogtags.com with what it is and how to reach you. We stop making anything we agree infringes, and we reply within 10 business days.
- **How long we keep images:** uploaded images are deleted within 120 days of your order, and declined images within 7 days. We keep a record that you ticked the box, when you ticked it, and a fingerprint of the file for 3 years.

## Monthly photo contest

**Short version:** each month we pick our favorite dog face and give that dog a free tag. No purchase necessary.

- **No purchase necessary.** You don't have to buy anything to enter or to win. Buying a tag does not improve your chances.
- **How to enter:** post a photo of your dog on Instagram, TikTok or Facebook with the hashtag **#SaltyDogTags**, or email the photo to [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com?subject=Tag%20pic). The dog can be wearing a Salty Dog Tag or any other tag.
- **Who can enter:** residents of the United States who are 18 or older, or a parent or guardian entering for a child.
- **How the winner is chosen:** this is a judged pick, not a random drawing. One winner each month, chosen by the owners of Salty Dog Tags for the best face. Entries are judged on the dog's face and nothing else, so the number of entries does not decide who wins.
- **The prize:** one free tag, in a shape of our choice. No cash value, no substitutions and no transfers.
- **Reposting:** entering lets us repost your photo with credit, as described under Tag us above.
- **Void where prohibited.**
- **Sponsor:** Salty Dog Tags, Lehi, Utah.

## Governing law

Utah law governs these policies and every sale, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Email us first; most things get fixed in one reply. If not, disputes go to the state or federal courts in Utah County, Utah, or to small claims court. None of this removes consumer protections you have where you live.

The version of these policies posted when you order applies to that order.

# Privacy Policy

> What Salty Dog Tags collects to make and ship your tag, who we share it with, how long we keep it, and your choices. We do not sell it and run no ad trackers.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/privacy/

Effective date: November 16, 2026

Salty Dog Tags is one person, one laser and seven English bulldogs in Lehi, Utah. Short version: we collect what we need to make and ship your tag, we don't sell it, and we don't run ad trackers.

## What we collect

**When you order**

- Name, email, and phone (optional).
- Your shipping address.
- What you want engraved (usually your dog's name and your number; that's the point), your tag choices, and notes for the engraver.
- For photo tags, the photo you upload.
- Any Salty Maze upgrade code you use.
- A scrambled (hashed) version of your IP address, saved with the order to help spot fraud or one source flooding the form. We do not store your actual IP address or your browser type with the order.

**Your card: we never see it.** You enter it on Clover's secure hosted checkout page. It goes to Clover and never touches our servers.

**"Roast my dog"**

- Your dog's name, any notes, the tone you pick, and the photo if you add one.
- We do **not** keep the photo. It's used once to write the roast, then dropped.
- We keep the dog's name, tone and the roast for 90 days, plus any thumbs up/down or note you leave. Short snippets of liked and disliked lines stay longer, with no expiry, to teach the roaster what's funny. A snippet can include a dog's name.

**Salty Maze**: your three initials and score go on that day's public leaderboard. If you win an upgrade code, we store it with a random device ID. No name, no email.

**Kept in your browser, not by us**: your cart, your 18+ confirmation, your last order number and email (for the thank-you page), and maze data (device ID, best score, initials, plays, sound). Clear your browser's site data and it's gone.

**Rate limits**: to stop bots, we count AI requests by a scrambled (hashed) IP, never the IP itself. The count expires within an hour.

**Analytics**: Cloudflare shows us basic traffic (pages, rough location, browser). No ad trackers or pixels. Cloudflare may set security cookies to block bots.

**Emails and tags**: anything you send or tag us in.

## Why we use it

To make, proof and ship your tag; take payment and charge Utah sales tax when it applies; keep the Bulldog Promise; run the roast and the maze; stop fraud and abuse; and keep records the law requires. We don't sell your personal information or share it for targeted ads.

## Who we share it with

- **Clover (Fiserv)**: payments. Gets your name, email, phone, items and tag text. Your card details go straight from you to Clover, under Clover's own privacy policy.
- **Cloudflare**: hosts the site, stores orders and photo-tag photos, and runs Workers AI, one of the roast's AI services.
- **Anthropic**: the main AI behind the roast. Gets the photo, name and notes. We don't keep the photo; Anthropic may hold it briefly under its own terms (by default up to 30 days, longer if flagged for a safety review).
- **USPS**: your name and address, to deliver.
- **Order alerts**: a short summary (name, total, tag text) pings the owner's phone through Pushover and/or Twilio.
- **Email**: our email provider carries messages you send us.
- Anyone the law requires, or when someone's safety is at risk. If the business is sold, records move under this same policy.

## How long we keep it

- Orders: until you ask us to delete them, except records we must keep for taxes.
- Uploaded photos and artwork (tags and ornaments): deleted within 120 days of your order; declined uploads within 7 days. We keep your rights confirmation, its time, and a file fingerprint for 3 years. If you ship a gift, we use the recipient's name and address only to deliver it.
- Roast photos: not kept. Roast text and feedback: 90 days. Liked and disliked line snippets: no expiry.
- Leaderboard: about a week. Upgrade codes: 31 days. Rate-limit counts: 1 hour.
- Reposts and Wall of Shame posts: until you ask us to take them down.

## Your choices

- Email us to see, fix or delete your info. We'll answer within 30 days. Some order records have to stay for taxes.
- Skip the photo on the roast. It still works from the name and notes.
- Tell us not to repost your dog, or ask us to take a post down anytime.
- Clear your browser's site data to wipe the cart, 18+ setting and maze data.
- We don't send marketing email.

## Kids

This site is for dog owners. It isn't aimed at children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their personal information. **Please don't upload photos of people, and especially kids, to "Roast my dog."** The roaster turns down photos that mainly show a person, but it's a robot, so keep kids out of the frame. If you think a child under 13 sent us information, email us and we'll delete it.

## Security, changes, contact

Orders and photos sit behind a key only the owner holds. Nothing online is perfectly safe, so we keep what we collect small. If this policy changes, we'll update this page and the date at the top.

Salty Dog Tags, Lehi, Utah. [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

# Funny Australian Shepherd (Aussie) Dog Tags

> Funny engraved tags for the Aussie who herds your kids and needs a job. Laser cut in Lehi, Utah, name and number on the back. From $12.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/aussie-dog-tags/

Engraved tags for the dog who herds your children, your guests and your vacuum. An Aussie with no job will invent one, and you will not like it.

Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number

Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

[Build my Aussie's tag](https://saltydogtags.com/#build) [or read all 12 Aussie sayings](https://saltydogtags.com/aussie-dog-tags/#sayings)

- **From $12 a tag** both sides engraved
- **Shipped in 1–2 business days** USPS 3–5 days, US only
- **Free remake** if we mis-engrave

## Built for a dog who never clocks out

Every Aussie owner has the same story. You took a long hike, you threw the ball for an hour, and the dog still stands at the door asking what is next. They were bred to work cattle all day, so a quiet Sunday looks to them like unemployment.

An Aussie with nothing to do will find a job. Herding the kids into one room is the classic, and the heel nips are meant kindly. The dog also follows you to the bathroom, the garage and the mailbox, because the one job they truly love is being your shadow.

That means a tag that gets dragged through brush, mud and kid pile-ups. Our text is laser engraved into the metal, so nothing wears off.

[How engraving holds up →](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/do-dog-tags-wear-off/)

## Which shape fits your Aussie

Tags here come in one size per shape, so picking a shape is picking a size. For an Aussie, the sweet spot is the bone, heart or paw. All three are Medium, about 1.5 inches, which suits a standard collar and a medium neck without swallowing it. Want it a little bigger? The military runs about 2 inches and gives long sayings room to breathe. Want it smaller? The round is about 1.2 inches. The polished stainless bone is the biggest we make at 48 mm, and it comes with a paw cut-out, which is handy if your Aussie also likes to be noticed. Every shape gets the same engraving: saying on the front, name and number on the back.

Stainless and brass add $4, polished adds $6. The preview in the builder is exactly what we engrave.

[Pick a shape in the builder →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)

Questions humans ask

## Aussie tag FAQ

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**Which tag shape fits an Aussie?**

Tags come in one size per shape, so picking a shape is picking a size. For an Aussie, the bone, heart or paw (all Medium, about 1.5 inches) is the sweet spot. Want it bigger? The military is about 2 inches. Want it smaller? The round is about 1.2 inches.

**Will mud, drool and rough play wear off the engraving?**

No. The text is laser engraved into the metal, so scuffing doesn't erase it.

**Can I put my Aussie's name and my phone number on the tag?**

Yes. Saying on the front, name and phone number on the back.

**Do you have sayings written specifically for Aussies?**

12 on this page. Each fits the tag as written.

**What should I put on an Australian Shepherd's tag?**

One joke for the front, two short lines at most, like Herds kids. Unpaid. Unstoppable. Put your dog's name and a phone number on the back. Aussies are escape artists, so the number matters more than the joke.

**What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?**

If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.

> Funny engraved tags for the Bernese, a 100-pound lap dog who sheds a second dog. Laser cut in Lehi, Utah, name and number on the back. From $12.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/bernese-dog-tags/

Engraved tags for the 100-pound lap dog who sheds a second dog every week and falls apart if you ignore him. Our bulldogs lean on you too, so we get it.

Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number

Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

[Build my Bernese's tag](https://saltydogtags.com/#build) [or read all 12 Bernese sayings](https://saltydogtags.com/bernese-dog-tags/#sayings)

- **From $12 a tag** both sides engraved
- **Shipped in 1–2 business days** USPS 3–5 days, US only
- **Free remake** if we mis-engrave

## Built for a very large dog with a very soft heart

A Bernese is a 100-pound dog who truly believes he is a lap dog. He will lean on your legs, sit on your feet and lie across the doorway so you cannot leave without stepping over him. If you ignore him for ten minutes, he will sigh like you ended the relationship.

The shedding is its own chapter. A Bernese sheds a second dog every week, and the fur ends up in the soup. Owners just call it seasoning. The drool comes in a close second, and the tag takes all of it, so we laser engrave the text into the metal.

Berners also love cold weather and hate warm days, and they are not marathon runners. A tag that stays readable on a thick tricolor ruff is the job.

[How engraving holds up →](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/do-dog-tags-wear-off/)

## Which shape fits your Bernese Mountain Dog

Tags here come in one size per shape, so the shape you pick sets the size. A Bernese Mountain Dog has a big head and a thick collar, and a small tag disappears against all that. Go with the military, about 2 inches, or the polished stainless bone, the biggest we make at 48 mm, with a paw cut-out. Both are easy to read at a glance and easy to find under the fur. The bone, heart and paw are Medium, about 1.5 inches. They work if you like a quieter tag, or if the collar is slim. Leave the round for the lapdogs. Every shape gets the same engraving: saying on the front, name and number on the back.

Stainless and brass add $4, polished adds $6. The preview in the builder is exactly what we engrave.

[Pick a shape in the builder →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)

Questions humans ask

## Boxer tag FAQ

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**Which tag shape fits a Boxer?**

Tags come in one size per shape, so picking a shape is picking a size. For a Boxer, the bone, heart or paw (all Medium, about 1.5 inches) is the sweet spot. Want it bigger? The military is about 2 inches. Want it smaller? The round is about 1.2 inches.

**Will drool and water wear off the engraving?**

No. The text is laser engraved into the metal, so there's no ink for drool or water to lift.

**Can I put my boxer's name and my phone number on the tag?**

Yes. Funny saying on the front, name and phone number on the back.

**Do you have sayings written specifically for boxers?**

Eight on this page, about the wiggle, the jumping and the never-ending puppy phase. Each fits the tag as written.

**Boxers overheat. Should the tag say so?**

If your boxer struggles in heat, a back-line note like "Keep me cool" can help a finder. Ask your vet about your own dog's limits.

# Bulldog Dog Tags

> Funny engraved bulldog dog tags: snoring, gas, loaf and wrinkle jokes on the front, name and number on the back. From $12, ships from Lehi, Utah.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/bulldog-dog-tags/

Engraved tags for the breed that snores through its own name being called. We make them in a house with seven English bulldogs, so the jokes aren't guesses.

Close-up of a laser-engraved bulldog dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number

Whisky's actual tag. Polished stainless, paw cut-out, straight off our laser.

[Build my bulldog's tag](https://saltydogtags.com/#build) [or read all 12 bulldog sayings](https://saltydogtags.com/bulldog-dog-tags/#sayings)

- **From $12 a tag** both sides engraved
- **Shipped in 1–2 business days** USPS 3–5 days, US only
- **Free remake** if we mis-engrave

## Bulldogs are hard on a tag. This one can take it.

A bulldog does not wear a tag so much as marinate it. Drool, slobber, the water bowl they half-climb into, the dirt they plow with their face, the nap in direct sun, the snoring that rattles the whole collar for six hours a night. Printed tags give up. Engraved ones don't.

We cut the words into the metal with a fiber laser. Nothing is painted on, so there's nothing to chip or peel off. On the colored tags, the laser lifts the anodized color and exposes bright silver underneath, so the letters stay readable as the tag gets scratched up. On stainless and brass, the mark goes dark and deep.

Slobber-proof is just a side effect of using metal instead of ink.

[Build a tag →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)

## Seven bulldogs, one laser, zero boring tags

We didn't start a tag company because we're crafty. We started it because we have seven English bulldogs in Lehi, Utah, they kept losing their tags, and the plain ones at the pet store cost more than a decent lunch. So we bought a laser and started making our own, with the jokes we were already making out loud.

Whisky's tag came first. Polished stainless, paw cut-out, four lines he did not approve. Everything on this site came after that one.

## Which shape fits your Bulldog

Tags here come in one size per shape, so the shape you pick sets the size. A Bulldog has a big head and a thick collar, and a small tag disappears against all that. Go with the military, about 2 inches, or the polished stainless bone, the biggest we make at 48 mm, with a paw cut-out. Both are easy to read at a glance and easy to find under the fur. The bone, heart and paw are Medium, about 1.5 inches. They work if you like a quieter tag, or if the collar is slim. Leave the round for the lapdogs. Every shape gets the same engraving: saying on the front, name and number on the back.

Stainless and brass add $4, polished adds $6. The preview in the builder is exactly what we engrave.

[Pick a shape in the builder →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)

Questions humans ask

## Bulldog tag FAQ

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**Which tag shape fits a Bulldog?**

Tags come in one size per shape, so the shape sets the size. A Bulldog has a big head and a thick collar, so go with the military (about 2 inches) or the polished stainless bone (48 mm, with a paw cut-out). The bone, heart and paw (about 1.5 inches) suit a slimmer collar. Leave the round for the lapdogs.

**Will drool and slobber ruin an engraved bulldog tag?**

No. The words are cut into the metal with a laser, not printed on top, so there's no ink to wash off. Anodized aluminum, stainless and brass all shrug off water.

**Can I put my bulldog's name and my phone number on the tag?**

Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name plus your phone number are engraved on the back. A third back line is optional.

**Do you have sayings written specifically for bulldogs?**

Twelve of them on this page, about snoring, gas, wrinkles, the underbite, the loaf shape and the stubbornness. There's a full bulldog category in our sayings list too.

**What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?**

Custom tags aren't returnable, but if we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Send a photo and we re-cut it. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.

## Built for the softest dog in the room

A Cavalier's silky ears also drag through the water bowl, so a tag that holds up to drool and dinner is a real need. Ours is laser engraved into the metal, so it stays readable.

(Sandwiches.)](https://saltydogtags.com/sayings/i-bite-sandwiches/) · [Good boy (legally disputed).](https://saltydogtags.com/sayings/good-boy-legally-disputed/) · [Will work for belly rubs. Union rules.](https://saltydogtags.com/sayings/will-work-for-belly-rubs/) · [Barks first. Thinks never.](https://saltydogtags.com/sayings/barks-first-thinks-never/) · [Ate homework. ## Related guides

[Dog Tag Size Guide by Breed](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/dog-tag-size-guide-by-breed/) · [Cat Tags vs Dog Tags](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/cat-tags-vs-dog-tags/) · [All guides →](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/)

Questions humans ask

## Chihuahua tag FAQ

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**Which tag shape fits a Chihuahua?**

Tags come in one size per shape, so the shape sets the size. For a Chihuahua, start with the round (about 1.2 inches) or the heart (about 1.5 inches). Both sit flat under a small chin. The military (about 2 inches) and the polished stainless bone (48 mm) are too big for a dog this size.

**Will a tag bother my chihuahua?**

A heavy one might. That's why we point small dogs to the round or the heart, the smaller shapes. They sit quieter, and they're less likely to clank against the food bowl and start a war.

**Can I put my chihuahua's name and my phone number on the tag?**

Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

**Will heat, salt air or pool water ruin the engraving?**

No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's nothing to fade or wash off.

**What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?**

If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.

## Pond water, humidity and the groomer can't take it

A doodle doesn't get wet. It absorbs. Pool water, pond water, sprinkler water, the humidity on a "dry" afternoon. All of it soaks into the fur, and the tag sits right in the middle of it for hours.

That's why we engrave instead of print. The words are cut into the tag with a laser, so there's no ink to wash out, fade or peel.

Your dog will still smell like a wet couch cushion. The tag will still be readable.

[How engraving holds up →](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/do-dog-tags-wear-off/)

Questions humans ask

## Goldendoodle & Labradoodle tag FAQ

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**Which tag shape fits a Doodle?**

Tags come in one size per shape, so the shape sets the size. A Doodle has a big head and a thick collar, so go with the military (about 2 inches) or the polished stainless bone (48 mm, with a paw cut-out). The bone, heart and paw (about 1.5 inches) suit a slimmer collar. Leave the round for the lapdogs.

**Will a tag get lost in my doodle's fur?**

A small one can. Doodle coats grow right over little tags, so go with the military or the polished stainless bone, which are big enough to stay visible.

**Will pool water, salt water or humidity ruin an engraved tag?**

No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's no ink to wash off.

**Can I put my doodle's name and my phone number on the tag?**

Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

**Can I write my own doodle saying?**

Yes. Type it into the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

**What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?**

If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.

# Frenchie Dog Tags

> Funny engraved French bulldog tags: bat ears, screaming and sploot jokes on the front, name and number on the back. From $12 a tag, engraved in Lehi, Utah.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/frenchie-dog-tags/

Engraved tags for the breed that screams like a goat, sploots on cold tile and judges the humidity harder than your mother-in-law. We live with seven English bulldogs, so we know the flat-faced cousin's act by heart.

Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number

Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

[Build my frenchie's tag](https://saltydogtags.com/#build) [or read all 8 frenchie sayings](https://saltydogtags.com/frenchie-dog-tags/#sayings)

- **From $12 a tag** both sides engraved
- **Shipped in 1–2 business days** USPS 3–5 days, US only
- **Free remake** if we mis-engrave

## Built for drool, humidity and the occasional water-bowl incident

A frenchie doesn't wear a tag so much as test it. Slobber, water-bowl face-plants, sticky summer air and the sand they track in after a beach day they complained through the entire time. Printed tags fade and peel when they meet all that.

Ours don't, because the words are laser-cut into the metal. There's no paint on top to chip, wash or sweat off. On colored tags the laser lifts the anodized color and exposes bright silver underneath; on stainless and brass the mark goes dark and deep.

The joke stays readable long after the summer is over, which in Florida means never.

[Build a tag →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)

## Which shape fits your Frenchie

Tags here come in one size per shape, so picking a shape is picking a size. For a Frenchie, the sweet spot is the bone, heart or paw. All three are Medium, about 1.5 inches, which suits a standard collar and a medium neck without swallowing it. Want it a little bigger? The military runs about 2 inches and gives long sayings room to breathe. Want it smaller? The round is about 1.2 inches. The polished stainless bone is the biggest we make at 48 mm, and it comes with a paw cut-out, which is handy if your Frenchie also likes to be noticed. Every shape gets the same engraving: saying on the front, name and number on the back.

Stainless and brass add $4, polished adds $6. The preview in the builder is exactly what we engrave.

[Pick a shape in the builder →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)

## Built for a dog that never clocks out

A German shepherd doesn't wear a tag. It takes the tag on patrol: fence-line sprints, pool laps in July, wrestling matches with the other dog, and a lot of scratching at a collar buried under a coat that never actually stops shedding.

Ours are laser engraved, so the words are cut into the metal instead of painted on top. On colored tags the laser lifts the anodized color and exposes bright silver underneath; on stainless and brass the mark goes dark. Mud, pool water and a full shedding season can't peel off something that isn't stuck on.

The joke outlasts the undercoat. Which is saying something.

## Built for a dog that hits things at tail height

A Great Dane's tag lives at counter level, which means it has seen things. It gets dragged across the kitchen counter mid-heist, dunked in a water bowl the size of a kiddie pool, and swung into every door frame in the house. Drool does the rest.

Every tag is laser engraved, so the words are cut into the metal instead of painted on top. There's no ink to chip, peel or wash off.

Shake your head and redecorate the walls. The tag can take it.

[How engraving holds up →](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/do-dog-tags-wear-off/)

## Which shape fits your Great Dane

Tags here come in one size per shape, so the shape you pick sets the size. A Great Dane has a big head and a thick collar, and a small tag disappears against all that. Go with the military, about 2 inches, or the polished stainless bone, the biggest we make at 48 mm, with a paw cut-out. Both are easy to read at a glance and easy to find under the fur. The bone, heart and paw are Medium, about 1.5 inches. They work if you like a quieter tag, or if the collar is slim. Leave the round for the lapdogs. Every shape gets the same engraving: saying on the front, name and number on the back.

Stainless and brass add $4, polished adds $6. The preview in the builder is exactly what we engrave.

[Pick a shape in the builder →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)

## Great Dane tag FAQ

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**Which tag shape fits a Great Dane?**

Tags come in one size per shape, so the shape sets the size. A Great Dane has a big head and a thick collar, so go with the military (about 2 inches) or the polished stainless bone (48 mm, with a paw cut-out). The bone, heart and paw (about 1.5 inches) suit a slimmer collar. Leave the round for the lapdogs.

**Will drool, water and humidity ruin an engraved tag?**

No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's nothing to wash off, peel or fade.

**Can I put my Great Dane's name and my phone number on the tag?**

Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

**How much does a Great Dane tag cost?**

Tags start at $12. Your Dane will cost considerably more, but that's between you and your grocery bill.

**What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?**

If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.

# The Best Dog Beaches on the Florida Gulf Coast (Tested by Professional Snugglers)

> Where to take your dog on Florida's Gulf Coast: real dog beaches from Pensacola to Bonita Springs, plus bulldog-tested tips. Check current rules first.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/guides/best-dog-beaches-florida-gulf-coast/

Salty Dog Tags · Updated Oct 13, 2026

The Florida Gulf Coast has sugar-white sand, warm water, and sunsets that look like an '80s album cover. It also has a lot of beaches where your dog is very much *not* invited. Nothing kills the vibe faster than hauling a cooler, an umbrella, and a 55-pound bulldog across a parking lot only to meet a sign with a little paw print and a big red slash through it.

We're a bulldog family in Utah that sells to Florida dog people, with seven English bulldogs. That's not a typo, and yes, it's loud. We make laser-engraved dog tags with a little too much attitude, and we've learned a few things about taking dogs somewhere sandy. Bulldogs are built for comfort, not speed. They can't swim, and they're still at the beach. They overheat if you look at them wrong. So when we talk about dog beaches, we're thinking about shade, water bowls, and an exit plan as much as the view.

Here are Gulf Coast dog beaches we're confident are real, dog-friendly spots, running roughly north to south. One important note before you load up the car: **rules change.** Leash policies, hours, fees, and access can shift with the season, local ordinances, and hurricane recovery. Check the official park or county website before you go. Every time. Even if you went last month.

[Make one in 2 minutes →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)or [let us roast your dog](https://saltydogtags.com/roast/) for the line.

## Before You Go: The Unglamorous Stuff That Matters

Here's the boring part first, because it's the part that keeps your dog alive and your day fun.

- **Heat is the real boss.** Florida sun is no joke, and flat-faced breeds like bulldogs, pugs, and Frenchies have a harder time cooling down. Go early in the morning or late in the afternoon. Skip midday in summer entirely.
- **Hot sand burns paws.** If it's too hot for the back of your hand, it's too hot for your dog's feet.
- **Bring fresh water.** Your dog will try to drink the Gulf. The Gulf will win. Pack a bowl and more water than seems reasonable.
- **Life vests aren't optional for non-swimmers.** Some breeds sink like a bag of sand. Ours qualify. A dog life jacket with a handle on top is a lifesaver, literally.
- **Rinse off after.** Salt and sand irritate skin, paws, and those deep face wrinkles. A quick freshwater rinse helps.
- **Watch for local hazards.** Red tide, jellyfish, stingrays, and washed-up fish are all part of Gulf life at different times of year. Check local conditions before you go.
- **Make sure the tag is current.** Off-leash beaches are exactly where a dog decides to take a self-guided tour. A tag with a working phone number is the fastest way home.

Got all that? Good. Now the sand.

## Pensacola Beach Dog Beaches (Santa Rosa Island)

Way up in the Panhandle, Pensacola Beach has two designated pet-friendly beaches on Santa Rosa Island, one at each end of the island. It's the classic Panhandle look: bright white sand, emerald-green water, and enough space for your dog to feel like the main character.

**Good to know:**

- The west one is by the Fort Pickens Road lot (21E, also called 21.5). The east one is by the Via de Luna lot (28B, also called 28.5). All other island beaches are closed to dogs, Casino Beach included. Dogs outside the marked zones can get you a conversation with someone in uniform.
- Leashes are required at all times.
- Hours run sunrise to sunset, and 7 a.m. to sunset during turtle season (May 1 to Oct 31).
- Bring your own shade. The Panhandle sun bounces off that white sand, and you'll feel it.

Check Escambia County and Santa Rosa Island Authority info for current locations and rules before you head over the bridge ([visitpensacolabeach.com](https://visitpensacolabeach.com/things-to-do-dog-beach/)).

## Pier Park Dog Beach (Panama City Beach)

Panama City Beach has a designated dog beach near Pier Park, which makes it an easy add-on to a PCB trip. You can get your beach time in, then go deal with the rest of humanity at the shops nearby.

**Good to know:**

- It's a designated stretch, so stay inside the posted boundaries.
- A leash is required, and your dog must stay under your command. Dogs need to be current on shots and **wear ID tags**, which is exactly the kind of rule we like.
- Max 3 dogs per person, no dogs under 4 months, no females in season, and a muzzle for dogs with a bite history. Fines start at $50 outside the boundaries.
- The beach is west of the Russell-Fields City Pier, in front of Pier Park. Confirm the current setup with the [city's dog page](https://pcbfl.gov/about-us/visitors/dogs) before you go.
- PCB gets crowded in peak season. If your dog is the "Small dog. Big mouth." type, a quieter weekday morning might save your nerves.

## Honeymoon Island State Park Pet Beach (Dunedin)

Honeymoon Island, just off Dunedin in Pinellas County, is one of the best-known dog beaches in the Tampa Bay area. The state park has a designated pet beach where leashed dogs can enjoy the Gulf. Your dog gets a real coastline, and you get a real nature-park feel instead of high-rises.

**Good to know:**

- Dogs need to be leashed. Florida State Parks generally require a leash no longer than six feet, so check the park's current pet policy.
- There's a park entrance fee, so plan for it.
- Pets are allowed on the designated pet beach, not on every beach in the park. Follow the signs.
- Shade can be limited, so an umbrella or pop-up shelter is worth bringing.
- Storm caveat: Hurricanes Helene and Milton closed the park in 2024. It partly reopened in late November 2024 with the pet beach open, though some facilities stayed closed into 2025. Check the [Florida State Parks page](https://www.floridastateparks.org/learn/activities-along-shore-honeymoon) for current status and the entrance fee.

Honeymoon Island is a great pick for dogs who like sniffing more than sprinting. That's basically every bulldog ever. They're not swimming. They're conducting an investigation.

[Make one in 2 minutes →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)or [let us roast your dog](https://saltydogtags.com/roast/) for the line.

## Fort De Soto Park Dog Beach & Paw Playground (Tierra Verde)

If Gulf Coast dog beaches had a headliner, it would be Fort De Soto. This Pinellas County park near Tierra Verde has a designated dog beach where dogs can be off-leash, plus the **Paw Playground**, a fenced dog park with separate areas for large and small dogs.

Off-leash beach time is the dream for a lot of dogs, and this is one of the places that actually allows it.

**Good to know:**

- The off-leash rules apply to the designated dog beach and Paw Playground only. Everywhere else in the park, follow the posted leash rules.
- Fort De Soto is popular. Weekends can get busy, so arrive early if you want parking and elbow room.
- Off-leash means your dog has choices. Some dogs make bad ones. If yours treats recall as a rumor, keep a long line handy or stick to the fenced Paw Playground.
- Rinse stations and water access can vary, so bring your own anyway.
- Storm caveat: the park closed after Hurricanes Helene and Milton in September 2024. The dog beach reopened January 6, 2025, and the county warned some areas might stay closed. Check [Pinellas County](https://pinellas.gov/news/fort-de-soto-park-fort-dog-beach-fishing-piers-reopen/) for current status.

This is the beach where a dog in a "Lifeguard (off duty)" tag fits right in. Supervising from a towel counts as working, right?

## Brohard Paw Park (Venice)

Venice calls itself the Shark Tooth Capital of the World, and Brohard Paw Park lets your dog join the hunt. It's a dog beach right on the Gulf in Sarasota County where dogs can enjoy the sand and water.

**Good to know:**

- Brohard Paw Park has had off-leash beach access, but confirm the current rules with Sarasota County before you go.
- The park has fenced small and large dog areas, plus dog showers and fountains, which helps with the rinse tip.
- Shark tooth hunting and a dog that eats everything can be a fun mix. Keep an eye out.
- Venice gets steady traffic year-round, especially in season, so earlier is better.

If your dog has ever eaten homework and found it delicious, keep an eye on what goes in that mouth here. Fossils aren't snacks, even if your dog strongly disagrees.

## Lee County Dog Beach (Between Fort Myers Beach and Lovers Key)

Down in Southwest Florida, Lee County runs an off-leash dog beach near the south end of Estero Island, close to Lovers Key. It's a tidal flat, so check the tide. It's known for shallow, calm water, which is great news for dogs whose swimming style is mostly "panic."

**Good to know:**

- This area was hit by Hurricane Ian in 2022 and again in 2024, and it reopened with limited amenities in October 2024. There's a portable toilet only, no restrooms, and a max of 2 dogs per person. Check Lee County's official information before you drive down.
- Calm, shallow water is ideal for wading. Even so, non-swimmers should wear a life jacket.
- Parking fees apply.

If you're traveling from Naples or Fort Myers, this is one of the most popular dog-friendly beach options in the area. Just make sure it's open before you promise your dog a beach day.

## A Few Honorable Rules of Thumb for Gulf Coast Dog Beaches

Not every beach on this list fits every dog. Here's a quick way to choose:

- **Off-leash lovers with solid recall:** Fort De Soto, Brohard Paw Park, Lee County Dog Beach (rules permitting).
- **Leashed sniffers and nature walkers:** Honeymoon Island.
- **Panhandle road trippers:** Pensacola Beach and Pier Park Dog Beach.
- **Bulldogs, pugs, and other flat-faced legends:** Whatever's closest, earliest, and shadiest. Keep it short. Leave before they hit their limit. They'll nap on the ride home with the confidence of a dog who did something important.

## After the Beach: Hydrate the Humans Too

Your dog gets a fresh water bowl. You deserve something better than lukewarm water from a bottle that's been sitting in a hot car. If there's a **Thirsty Beaches** near your route home, it's an easy post-beach drink stop to cool off while your dog dries out in the back seat (full disclosure: that's our other business). Check their website for current locations and hours before you plan around it.

Then go home, rinse the dog, and vacuum the sand out of places sand shouldn't be able to reach.

Before your dog's next self-guided beach tour, make sure they're wearing something that gets them home and makes the finder laugh. Find laser-engraved tags with plenty of salt at [saltydogtags.com](https://saltydogtags.com/). Beach bum. Return to sand.

*This article is general information, not legal advice, and it is not a substitute for checking official sources. Animal-control laws, leash rules, beach hours, fees and access change, sometimes overnight after storms. Florida's statewide rabies requirement is in Florida Statutes section 828.30. Licensing, tag and leash rules are set by your county and city. Before you rely on anything here, confirm it with your county animal services office, the city, county or state park that runs the beach, and your veterinarian. Salty Dog Tags is not responsible for changes made after publication.*

Questions humans ask

## FAQ

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**Are dogs allowed on all Florida Gulf Coast beaches?**

No. Many Gulf Coast beaches don't allow dogs, and the ones that do usually limit them to designated areas. Always check the official city, county, or state park website for current rules before you go.

**Which Gulf Coast dog beaches allow dogs off-leash?**

Fort De Soto Park's dog beach and Paw Playground are well-known off-leash spots. Brohard Paw Park in Venice and the Lee County Dog Beach near Lovers Key have also allowed off-leash dogs. Rules can change, so confirm before you unclip.

**Is Honeymoon Island dog-friendly?**

Yes. Honeymoon Island State Park has a designated pet beach, and dogs must be on a 6-ft leash. A park entrance fee applies. Check the Florida State Parks website for the latest pet policy.

**Can bulldogs and other flat-faced breeds go to the beach?**

They can, with care. Flat-faced breeds overheat easily, so go during cooler hours, bring shade and plenty of fresh water, and keep visits short. If your dog can't swim, use a life jacket. Talk to your vet if you're unsure what your dog can handle.

**What should I put on my dog's beach tag?**

At minimum, a phone number you'll actually answer. Many owners also add the dog's name and a note like "microchipped" or a medical alert. Room for a joke is optional, but recommended.

# 100 Bulldog Names, Grouped by Theme (With Jokes Where They Help)

> 100 bulldog names grouped by theme, from food names to old-man names, picked by a family with seven English bulldogs. Plus tag-worthy jokes.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/guides/bulldog-names/

Salty Dog Tags · Updated Oct 13, 2026

You just brought home a bulldog. Congratulations. You now own a snoring, wheezing, opinionated sack of love that will sleep on your feet, eat your flip-flops, and stare at you like *you're* the problem.

Now it needs a name.

We know the struggle. We're a family with seven English bulldogs in Lehi, Utah, and we've spent a lot of time yelling names across the yard to see which ones a bulldog will ignore least. (Spoiler: they ignore all of them. Some just do it with more dignity.)

So we put together 100 bulldog names, grouped by theme, with a dry little joke wherever one helps. Whether your new pup is lounging under a ceiling fan in Tampa or sulking through a snowstorm, there's a name here that fits the attitude.

[Make one in 2 minutes →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)or [let us roast your dog](https://saltydogtags.com/roast/) for the line.

## How to Pick a Bulldog Name (The Short Version)

Before the list, a few honest tips from people who engrave names onto tags for a living:

- **Do the yell test.** Stand in your backyard (or a Publix parking lot, if you're brave) and shout it. If you feel embarrassed, good. That's the bulldog experience.
- **One or two syllables works best.** "Gus" carries. "Sir Reginald Wobbleton the Third" does not, especially when he's eating something off the sidewalk.
- **Think about the tag.** Shorter names leave room on a dog tag for a phone number and a joke. Priorities. (Here's [what to put on a dog tag](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/what-to-put-on-a-dog-tag/).)
- **Match the face.** Bulldogs have faces that look like they're worried about their taxes. Lean into it.

## Old Man Names (For Bulldogs Born Retired)

Bulldogs come out of the box with the energy of a guy who complains about the thermostat. These names just make it official.

## Putting the Name on a Tag (Where It Actually Matters)

A name is only useful if the nice stranger who finds your escaped bulldog can read it. Bulldogs don't run far. They mostly lie down somewhere inconvenient and wait to be discovered. But a tag is still the fastest way home.

A few things we've learned engraving tags:

- **Name, phone number, and something memorable.** A good joke makes people actually read the tag instead of just glancing at it.
- **Keep it legible.** Laser engraving holds up well, but a super long name squeezed onto a small tag doesn't do anyone favors.
- **Microchip too.** A tag gets you a phone call. A chip is the backup. Use both.

And yes, "Microchipped. Still dumb." is a real saying in [our builder](https://saltydogtags.com/#build). More bulldog lines are on our [bulldog tags page](https://saltydogtags.com/bulldog-dog-tags/), and the smaller cousins get their own [French bulldog names](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/french-bulldog-names/). Your bulldog will wear it with pride, mostly because they don't know what it says.

Found the perfect name? Put it on something with a little attitude. Build a laser-engraved tag in [the builder](https://saltydogtags.com/#build) or start from our [bulldog sayings](https://saltydogtags.com/bulldog-dog-tags/), made by a family that's been snored at by seven bulldogs and wouldn't have it any other way.

Questions humans ask

## FAQ

Still stuck? [hello@saltydogtags.com](mailto:hello@saltydogtags.com). A human answers. The dogs supervise.

**What's a good name for a male English bulldog?**

Classic picks like Winston, Tank, Gus, and Meatball suit the breed's tough-but-goofy vibe. Old-man names like Walter or Harold work especially well, since most bulldogs act like they've been retired since birth.

**What's a good name for a female English bulldog?**

Mabel, Doris, Pearl, Duchess, and Butterbean are all solid. Old-lady names fit the "runs the household and judges everyone in it" energy many bulldog girls have.

**Should a bulldog's name be short?**

Usually, yes. One or two syllables is easier to call out, easier for your dog to pick up, and easier to fit on a tag alongside your phone number. You can always have a long formal name and a short everyday one.

**Can I rename a bulldog I adopted?**

Generally, yes. Many dogs learn a new name with consistency and plenty of treats. Use it often, pair it with good things, and be patient. Bulldogs respond to snacks far faster than they respond to logic.

**Are funny names okay for bulldogs?**

Absolutely. Bulldogs are walking comedy. A funny name just means you're being honest about who you live with. Just make sure it's something you're comfortable yelling at the vet's office and the dog park.

# Cat Tags vs Dog Tags: What Actually Differs (Breakaway Collars, Size, Text)

> Cat tags and dog tags aren't interchangeable. Here's how breakaway collars, tag size, and engraving text differ, from a family with seven bulldogs.

Canonical page: https://saltydogtags.com/guides/cat-tags-vs-dog-tags/

Salty Dog Tags · Updated Oct 13, 2026

We run a dog tag company. We live with seven English bulldogs in Lehi, Utah. Our house sounds like a leaf blower convention at 2 a.m.

So why are we writing about cats?

Because people ask. A lot. Usually it goes like this: "Can I just put one of your dog tags on my cat?" And the honest answer is: maybe, but probably not the way you're picturing.

Cats and dogs are both animals that wander off and expect you to feel bad about it. But the gear that gets them home differs in a few important ways. The collar works differently. The tag needs to be smaller. And the text has to fit on something about the size of a fingernail.

Here's the breakdown, minus the fluff (the bulldogs supply plenty of that).

[Make one in 2 minutes →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)or [let us roast your dog](https://saltydogtags.com/roast/) for the line.

## The Big One: Breakaway Collars

This is the difference that matters most, so we're starting here.

**Cat collars are typically breakaway collars.** That means the buckle is designed to pop open under pressure. Cats climb, squeeze under decks, slip through fences, and wedge themselves into places that make no physical sense. If a collar snags on a branch or a fence post, a breakaway buckle releases so the cat doesn't get stuck or choked.

**Dog collars usually aren't.** Most dog collars use a standard buckle or snap that stays shut, because you clip a leash to them. A collar that pops open every time your dog lunges at a squirrel is not a collar. It's a suggestion.

Our bulldogs, for the record, do not climb trees. They do not climb anything. They have, at most, climbed onto the couch with assistance and a lot of grunting. Built for comfort, not speed.

### What this means for tags

The breakaway thing changes how you think about the tag itself:

- **The collar may come off.** That's the point. So a tag on a breakaway collar is a good first line of ID, but it shouldn't be the only line. Microchip your cat. Register the chip. Update the chip when you move. (Yes, you. We know you haven't.)
- **The tag shouldn't defeat the breakaway.** Don't attach a tag in a way that hooks the collar to something else or adds a second loop that could snag. Keep it simple and close to the collar.
- **Never clip a leash to a breakaway collar.** If you walk your cat (respect), use a harness. The collar's job is ID, not restraint.

For dogs, the standard collar is doing double duty: ID holder and leash anchor. That's why dog tags can be a little bigger and a little heavier without much fuss. The collar's staying put.

## Size: Your Cat Is Not a Small Bulldog

Even though some of our bulldogs have the energy of a sleepy house cat, cats are generally smaller, lighter, and much pickier about what's hanging off their necks.

### Cat tag size

Cat tags tend to be small. Think roughly the size of a dime to a nickel, sometimes a touch larger for bigger cats. The goal is a tag that:

- Doesn't bang into the food bowl every time they eat
- Doesn't drag down a lightweight collar
- Doesn't annoy the cat into a lifelong grudge against you (more than usual)

Some cat owners skip dangling tags entirely and use **slide-on tags** that sit flat against the collar. No jingle, no swing, less snag risk.

### Dog tag size

Dog tags have more range. A Chihuahua and a Great Dane are technically the same species, which is frankly absurd. Small dogs get the smaller shapes (a [chihuahua](https://saltydogtags.com/chihuahua-dog-tags/) starts with our round or heart). Big dogs can carry bigger ones (a [Great Dane](https://saltydogtags.com/great-dane-dog-tags/) wears the military or the polished stainless bone). Our [size guide by breed](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/dog-tag-size-guide-by-breed/) covers the rest. [Bulldogs](https://saltydogtags.com/bulldog-dog-tags/) can wear a tag with real presence, which is good, because they have real presence. And real neck rolls.

A standard dog tag gives you more surface area for text, which brings us to the fun part.

### Weight and material

Since size and weight go together, material matters more for cats:

- **Aluminum** is lightweight and a solid choice for small pets and cats.
- **Stainless steel** is tougher and holds up to chewing, scratching, and general chaos. A little heavier.
- **Brass** looks great but adds weight and can tarnish.

If you're in Florida, think about the air. Salt, humidity, beach days, and a dog who insists on rolling in something dead at the tide line. Materials that resist corrosion are worth it there; we compared them in [stainless vs aluminum vs brass](https://saltydogtags.com/guides/stainless-vs-aluminum-vs-brass-dog-tags/). Your tag should survive Florida even if your patience doesn't.

## Noise: The Jingle Problem

Dogs, as a rule, do not care about jingling tags. Our bulldogs jingle, snort, wheeze, and toot with confidence. A little metal clinking is the least of anyone's concerns.

Cats are different. Plenty of cats find a jingling tag irritating, and some will spend real effort trying to get rid of it. Some owners also find it annoying when the tag clicks against the water bowl at 3 a.m.

Options:

- **Slide-on tags** that sit flat on the collar
- **Tag silencers** (rubber sleeves or edges that soften the clink)
- **One tag only.** Not the ID tag, the rabies tag, the vet tag, and a decorative charm. Your cat is not a keychain.

Some people *want* a little noise on outdoor cats so birds get a heads-up. That's your call. Just know that some cats will treat it as a personal insult.

[Make one in 2 minutes →](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)or [let us roast your dog](https://saltydogtags.com/roast/) for the line.

## Text: What Fits, What Matters, What's Funny

Here's where cat tags and dog tags really split.

### Less room means harder choices

A small cat tag might fit a few short lines. That's it. You don't get room for a name, two phone numbers, an address, a medical note, and a joke. You have to prioritize.

**For a cat tag, in order of importance:**

- **A phone number.** This is the whole point. If someone can only read one thing, make it this.
- **The cat's name** (optional, honestly). Some people like it, some skip it for space.
- **A key status line**, like "Indoor cat," "Microchipped," or "Needs meds."

"Indoor cat" is a big one. If someone finds your cat outside and the tag says indoor cat, they know it's not just a neighborhood roamer. It's an escapee. Call immediately.

### Dog tags have more breathing room

A standard dog tag can usually hold more: name, phone, a second number, maybe a short medical note, and still have space for personality. That's where we live.

Our whole business is built on the idea that a tag can do its job *and* make the person who finds your dog laugh. A stranger is far more likely to call when the tag says:

**“Microchipped. Still dumb.”**

or

**“Don't follow me. I'm lost too.”**

or, for our people:

**“Snores louder than dad.”**

Short setup. Short punch. Phone number on the back. Everybody wins, especially the dog, who gets returned and immediately demands a snack.

### Can you put jokes on a cat tag?

You can. You just have to be ruthless with word count. Two short lines, max. Something like:

**“Indoor cat. Clearly lying.”**

or

**“Not lost. Ignoring you.”**

That's about all the room you've got. Cats would probably prefer that anyway. They're not chatty. They're judgmental.

### Engraving legibility

Small tags mean small text, and small text means legibility matters. A few tips that apply to both species, but especially cats:

- **Fewer words, bigger letters.** A readable phone number beats a clever paragraph nobody can see.
- **High contrast.** Laser engraving on a contrasting surface reads more clearly than faint scratches on shiny metal.
- **Deep enough to last.** Tags get scraped on concrete, chewed by siblings, and dunked in water bowls. Laser engraving holds up well because it marks the surface instead of just printing on top of it.

We laser-engrave everything we make. Partly because it lasts. Partly because our bulldogs have tested the limits of everything else in this house, and we prefer things that survive.

## Attachment: Rings, Hooks, and Slides

How the tag connects to the collar matters more than people think.

- **Split rings** (keyring-style) are secure but can be a pain to put on. They're common on dog tags and work for cats too, as long as they don't add extra snag points.
- **S-hooks** are easy to attach but can open over time. Check them. Crimp them closed if needed.
- **Slide-on tags** skip the dangle entirely. Popular for cats and for dogs who swim, roll, or generally behave like a wet sandbag.

For cats on breakaway collars, the simplest attachment is usually the best. One ring, one tag, close to the collar.

For dogs, especially beach dogs in Florida, check the ring now and then. Saltwater is hard on hardware, and so is a bulldog who treats every puddle like a spa.

## Quick Comparison

| | Cat Tags | Dog Tags

| **Collar type** | Usually breakaway | Usually standard buckle/snap

| **Size** | Small, lightweight | Wide range by breed

| **Text space** | Very limited | More room

| **Priority text** | Phone number, "Indoor cat" | Phone, name, optional extras

| **Noise tolerance** | Often low | Usually doesn't care

| **Leash on collar?** | No. Use a harness. | Yes, typically

Cats get the tiny breakaway tag and the silent judgment. Dogs get the bigger tag and the bigger jokes. If you've got a dog with opinions, a snore problem, or a deep commitment to naps and spite, we've got a tag for that in [the builder](https://saltydogtags.com/#build). Seven bulldogs approved it. Mostly by sleeping on it.

- [Free**Roast my dog →** — One photo and a name. We write the jokes, you pick one for the tag.](https://saltydogtags.com/roast/)
- [From $12**Build a tag →** — Pick a line or write your own. Name and number go on the back.](https://saltydogtags.com/#build)

[Browse every saying →](https://saltydogtags.com/sayings/)
